notes.title: DEMO going live for the weekend, it's "Pitch Ya Game" time!
notes.content:
Gladiators, take a knee! 🦵

Someone left the gates unlocked for the weekend, and everyone's headed back to the arena.

[b]LANISTA's demo is LIVE[/b] in celebration of our participation in "Pitch Ya Game"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949030/a460bfa45b79f1e7705e1c113dbda4ac8a21dd86.gif[/img]

[b]The demo will once again be available for a week[/b], this time with a couple of updates and previews of what's to come, including some rad-looking cybernetic augments that you can take a peek at!

Finally, as always, please do get back to us with any bug reports and feedback.

Have fun cracking skulls at the arena!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - V.0.0.0.5
notes.content:
Rejoice, Gladiators!

[b]Patch 0.0.0.5 is live[/b], updating the Demo with some bug fixes, balance changes and new loot tables!

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

→ Mutilate chance will now properly detach those pesky limbs.

→ Armless Gladiators, fear not, you may now resort to headbutting your enemies!

→ Endurance, dexterity and strength are now properly displaying their stat modifiers in the Profile page.

→ Fixed a bug that could break the Mercator's shop upon refreshing it.

→ Fixed a bug that was incorrectly displaying the stats on an item if it was being compared with an another that was stored in the stash.

→ Severed limbs can no longer be used to mutilate enemies. You'll be needing a blade for that!

→ Equipment is properly unequipped from enemies upon their deaths (if the drop chance gods allow it).

→ Stash slots, Mercator slots and fight slots no longer reset when your Gladiator perishes, allowing you to keep that progression

→ Loot rarity has been temporarily buffed so you can experiment with cooler, better items way earlier in the demo

notes.title: DEMO available for a week!
notes.content:
Gladiators, take a knee! 🦵

[b]LANISTA's demo is LIVE[/b] for the first time ever!

notes.title: LANISTA: Shadows and Dust is revealed!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome, Gladiators![/b] 💪

Today is indeed a glorious day. The wind blows softly, the sun shines with scorching heat and the crowds grow restless, for the arena has been revealed and will soon be ready for combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949030/3a94b4f309a6e0d41db72fb1ef18cfaa249515f6.gif[/img]

We are super excited to share more about the game in the coming weeks - [b]as well as getting a kickass demo out ASAP for you to enjoy[/b] - so expect a LOT of cool announcements soon™!

[h2]WISHLIST the game to stay in the loop (pretty please!)[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2894330/

Meanwhile, because we love what we do and take great pride in our work as a development team, we'd like to introduce ourselves with a tidbit about us mortals behind the curtain. Nice to meet you!

[h2]About Digitality Games[/h2]

[b]Digitality Games[/b] is a Portuguese indie company in its 6th year of activity in the industry, having previously released [b]HordeCore[/b] as well as [b]Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire[/b] across multiple platforms. We're a team of young, passionate, and slightly silly humanoids. Oh, and a dog. There's a dog in our office. 

[b]Carolina[/b] – Art & Design Lead
[b]Gonçalo[/b] – Programming Lead
[b]Inês[/b] – Programming & UI/UX Lead
[b]Luís[/b] – Director & Animation Lead
[b]Bullet[/b] - Office Security & Being A Dog Lead
